name: Parcels_2022Roll
title: 2022 Roll Assessor Parcels Feature Layer
description: This feature set was created utilizining an assortment of recorded documents: Subdivisions, Parcel Maps, Condominium Tracts, Deeds, etc. Each polygon is identified by a unique Assessor Identification Number (AIN).
snippet: This is the foundation from which all the Assessor Map Book pages are created, as well as to provide the base for locating properties within the County to aid in the assessment process.
accessInformation: Mapping & GIS Services, Office of the Assessor, Los Angeles County.
